Nimbārka
or Nimbāditya or Niyamānanda. 12th Cent.; founder of Dvaitādvaita school; son of Jagannātha an. Sarasvatī; a Telugu Brahmin resident of Nimba or Nimbapura in Bellary D..; lived after Rāmānuja; preceptor of Audumbaraṛṣi (a. of Vratapañcakanirṇaya. IO. 2487; a. of Śiṣṭagītā. BORI. 83 of 1882-83 an. Sannyāsapaddhati. BORI. 128 of 1882-83).
For a. account of his life, date an. works see Intro. p.. 1-17 of Vedānta Pārijāta Saurabha, Bib. Ind. 259; also S. N. Dasgupta, His.. of Ind. Philosophy III. p.. 399 ff.; an. Bhr. p. 212 for a list of his successors.
